title: Incrassate
summary: INCRAS'SATE, verb transitive [Latin incrasso, incrassatus; in and crassus, thick.] 1. To make thick or thicker; to thicken; the contrary to attenuate. 2. In pharmacy, to make fluids thicker by the mix

inlines.v: INCRAS'SATE, verb transitive [Latin incrasso, incrassatus; in and crassus, thick.] 1. To make thick or thicker; to thicken; the contrary to attenuate. 2. In pharmacy, to make fluids thicker by the mixture of other substances less fluid, or by evaporating the thinner parts. Acids dissolve or attenuate; alkalies precipitate or incrassate INCRAS'SATE, verb intransitive To become thick or thicker. INCRAS'SATE
